patch.value: GH-1076: read-only duplicates rejects universal JSON output controls
GitHub issue #1076 reports that pm duplicates emits structured TOON but is classified as a non-read surface, so universal JSON, lean, and token-accounting controls are refused.

Add red-first CLI/runtime contract coverage; return valid JSON with all existing duplicate result fields; declare applicable universal controls in the capability registry; preserve bounded default TOON and read-only behavior; cover CLI and SDK action parity.
Run pm duplicates --since 2026-08-20 --output-format json on 2026.8.21; observe universal-output refusal despite successful structured TOON output without the flag.
Read-only duplicate diagnostics support stable JSON and declare the applicable projection, budget, lean, and token-accounting controls.
The command is globally classified as non-read and refuses JSON output.
